title: 第19章 九曜镇灵日月凌天第20章 大家都是有缘人
slug: 转世成女开局攻略气运之子
content_zh:
【警告，“离炎玉纹鼎”已被雷劫锁定，请宿主尽管远离，前往安全地域】
【警告，“离炎玉纹鼎”已被雷劫锁定，请宿主尽快远离，前往安全地域......】
接连数道提示，让方玉凝警觉。
天地间，万物生异，必会引动天劫。
修行之人飞升，丹药、器物晋升品阶，这些都算是异象。
会自动触发天道，降下天劫。
这既是惩罚，也是馈赠。
渡不过，身死道消，一身气运重回天地。
渡过，则受天地青睐，诸般气运加身。
她是怎么也没想到，离炎玉纹鼎，会引发天劫！
被告知即将有天劫降下，方玉凝第一反应，就是将鼎收入仓库。
可惜，并未成功。
气机锁定之下，她根本无法让鼎挪动分毫。
先不说这离炎玉纹鼎能不能抗住天劫，自己这些药草，都得跟着遭殃。
“系统，有办法不渡这天劫嘛，或者换个地方也行。”
【告知：可为“离炎玉纹鼎”施加封印，需消耗2000情绪值】
【目前情绪值：5231】
方玉凝眉头一挑，心中有些肉疼。
这两千情绪值不知得积攒到什么时候才能够本。
但眼下，她若是不施加封印，那损失估计只多不少！

“施加封印！”
只是一瞬间，方玉凝便立刻做出决定。
雷劫声势浩荡，若是真让“玉纹鼎”在此渡劫。
这九品灵宝不知道会引来多少人觊觎。
守着气运之子在，这些气运值她很快就能涨回来。
但要是等离炎玉鼎渡完雷劫再收回，一切恐怕就晚了。
【告知：已扣除2000情绪值，正在为离炎玉纹鼎施加封印】
随着方玉凝话音落下，系统也很快做出回应。
数道暗色的圆环落在那华光流转的玉鼎上。
下一刻，那玉鼎顿时变得黯淡无光，鼎上铭文神韵也渐渐消散。
穹顶之上，雷龙蹙然一滞。
失去目标后，雷劫自行消散。
乌云褪去，让阳光重新照射进来。
远处，几道朝这边飞驰流光，也在这时停下。
仔细看去，每一个竟都是气息强大的武者。
“什么情况？劫云散了？！”
“这是渡完劫了......还是...”
一时间众人心生疑惑，同行三两人更是议论纷纷。
“扯淡，谁家渡劫一道雷都没劈下来！”
“那...老天爷搞错了？”
content_en:
[Warning, "Li Yan Jade Pattern Cauldron" has been locked by Thunder Tribulation, please stay away from the host and go to a safe area]
[Warning, "Li Yan Jade Pattern Cauldron" has been locked by Thunder Tribulation, please stay away from the host as soon as possible and go to a safe area...]
Several prompts in succession made Fang Yuning alert.
All things in heaven and earth are different, which will inevitably lead to heavenly catastrophe.
Practitioners ascend, and elixirs and utensils advance to higher levels. These are all considered strange phenomena.
It will automatically trigger the way of heaven and bring down the heavenly calamity.
This is both punishment and gift.
If you can't survive it, your body will die and your destiny will disappear, and your destiny will return to heaven and earth.
If you cross it, you will be favored by heaven and earth and be blessed with all kinds of luck.
She never thought that the Li Yan Jade Pattern Cauldron would cause a catastrophe!
After being told that a catastrophe was coming, Fang Yuning's first reaction was to put the tripod into the warehouse.
Unfortunately, it was not successful.
With the Qi machine locked, she couldn't move Ding at all.
Let’s not talk about whether the Liyan Jade Pattern Cauldron can withstand the catastrophe, but these medicinal herbs will also suffer.
"System, there is a way to avoid this catastrophe, or we can change places."
[Notice: A seal can be applied to the "Li Yan Jade Pattern Cauldron", which requires 2,000 emotional points to be consumed]
[Current sentiment value: 5231]
Fang Yuning raised her eyebrows, feeling a little painful in her heart.
I don’t know how long it will take to save these two thousand emotions.
But right now, if she doesn't impose a seal, the loss will probably be much greater!
"Impose a seal!"
In just a moment, Fang Yuning made a decision immediately.
The thunder tribulation is so powerful that if the "Jade Pattern Cauldron" is really allowed to survive the tribulation here.
I don’t know how many people will covet this ninth-grade spiritual treasure.
As long as the son of luck is here, she will be able to increase these luck values ​​​​quickly.
But if I wait until the Yanyu Cauldron has gone through the thunder tribulation before taking it back, it may be too late.
[Notification: 2000 emotional points have been deducted and a seal is being applied to the Liyan Jade Pattern Cauldron]
As Fang Yuning finished speaking, the system responded quickly.
Several dark rings fell on the jade tripod where the light was flowing.
The next moment, the jade tripod suddenly became dim, and the charm of the inscription on the tripod gradually disappeared.
On the dome, the Thunder Dragon paused for a moment.
After losing the target, the thunder tribulation dissipates on its own.
The dark clouds faded, allowing the sun to shine in again.
In the distance, several streams of light were flying towards this direction, and they also stopped at this moment.
Looking carefully, each one is actually a warrior with a powerful aura.
"What happened? The clouds of calamity have dispersed?!"
"Is this the end of the tribulation... or..."
For a moment, everyone was confused, and the three or two people traveling with him were even talking about it.
"Nonsense, no one in the Tribulation family has struck down a single thunderbolt!"
"Then...God made a mistake?"
